decisions.reason: The Magento shop template is still actively promoted and fills a niche for e-commerce clients, so it is worth continuing.
The responsive website template is only briefly mentioned but may serve existing web design clients, so we keep it while evaluating demand.
Premium customer support aligns with the firm's service business and can generate recurring revenue, so it should be retained.
The software version management tool has a dedicated page, indicating strategic importance, so we keep it.
The online tool for data processing contracts addresses GDPR compliance and has its own page, making it a valuable offering to retain.
